title: Muscle fibre types
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:35Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The bank point covers fast- and slow-twitch fibre types but does not teach the brief's second idea, that fibre arrangement affects force, so it is broader or narrower than the new point rather than the same idea.

draft.title: Muscle fibre types
card: fibres contract slowly and with less force, but they resist fatigue. They use oxygen well, so they suit long, steady efforts.
fibres contract quickly and with great force, but they tire fast. They suit short, powerful efforts.
Most muscles hold a mix of both types. The mix differs between people and between muscles, so it affects which events suit an athlete.

Fibre arrangement also affects force. In a pennate muscle the fibres sit at an angle to the tendon, so many fit in and the muscle can produce more force. In a parallel muscle the fibres run along its length, so it shortens further.
draft.remember: Slow-twitch lasts, fast-twitch hits hard, and fibre arrangement shapes force.

a.q: Which muscle fibre feature best suits a marathon runner's calf muscle?
opts: Fast-twitch fibres that produce great force
a.why: A marathon is a long, steady effort, so fibres that resist fatigue are needed. That describes slow-twitch fibres. Fast-twitch fibres give more force, but they tire quickly.
a.clue: Think about which fibres keep going for hours.

b.q: Dani is a 100 m sprinter in Geelong. Her coach says her leg muscles have a high share of one fibre type. Which fits her event, and why?
opts: Fast-twitch, because they give quick, powerful bursts
Slow-twitch, because they give quick, powerful bursts
Fast-twitch, because they resist fatigue for long periods
Slow-twitch, because they resist fatigue for long periods
b.why: A sprint is a short effort that needs high force at speed, which suits fast-twitch fibres. Slow-twitch fibres do resist fatigue, but that matters little in a race of about 11 seconds.
b.clue: A sprint is over in seconds, so tiring matters less than power.

b.best: Fast-twitch, because they give quick, powerful bursts
